timing_scope: Process wall time around the fixed-work inference invocations, including startup and model loading. Source overlay preparation and separate trace runs are excluded.
comparison: The normalized Quiver comparison removes known output-path prefixes from tag fields. All other payload bytes, including atom order, coordinates, residue identities, and score text, are compared.

raw_internal_trace.coverage: Initial state, each diffusion step, and Python, NumPy, Torch CPU and CUDA RNG states.
raw_internal_trace.kernel_cache: The exact-mode trace was checked with an initially empty Triton cache and isolated cache-filename RNG.

cases.input_length_scope: Target and framework before CDR sampling. Candidate residue counts may differ.

limits: One timed stock/exact pair per fixture size on one RTX 4090 D.
The tested fixture sizes are short and typical. The evidence covers stage inference.
